correctness.rationale: The cubic intrinsic-volume coefficients are independently obtained from the support function, surface area and volume; exact discriminant reduces to (4Q^3-H^2)/27. Differentiation produces strictly positive sum-of-squares derivatives for F± whenever Q>0. A proven global inequality m^3>9πt ensures negative H at all Q=0 boundaries. This excludes hidden bounded components and proves two and only two crossings on the final unbounded component, with correct double-root and negative-real-root classifications. The standalone checker successfully verifies algebraic identities, a rational bound, and high-precision numerical thresholds; numerics are supplementary, not the proof.

value.rationale: An exact all-aspect-ratio real-rootedness classification for a basic 3D convex body resolves a natural gap between universal Wills root-location theorems and known exact Steiner root phases. The unexpectedly narrow window and explicit rigid two-transition count are intrinsic-volume geometric facts, not an arbitrary numerical slice or routine table recomputation. The derivative identity and boundary exclusion are structural lemmas applicable to an entire continuous cone family.
